workflows.name: Extension Installation & Onboarding
steps: Background script gets or generates a unique machine key (UUID v4).
Sets the uninstall URL for the extension, including extension version and machine key.
Creates a context menu item 'Search this image on faircado' for image context.
Tracks 'extension_installed_background' event to Mixpanel with browser and machine key.

Opens a new tab to an after-install URL. For Firefox, it opens 'data-control.html'; otherwise, it opens a Faircado onboarding URL (dynamic based on A/B test).
        ('chrome.tabs.create', 'extension/background.js', 544, 548)

workflows.name: Product Page Detection & Information Extraction
workflows.trigger: Initial page load or URL change in content script, triggered by background.js messages or navigation events.
steps: Content script checks if the current frame is the main frame.
Checks if data control is accepted (for Firefox).

Fetches supported websites data from background script (which may involve API call to https://cms-api.faircado.com/api/supported-websites/list or https://catalog-service-api.faircado.com/api/v1/supported-website).
Determines page data extraction mode (selectors or metadata).
If embedded view is enabled and supported for the host (Amazon, Google, Ecosia), it injects an embedded iframe and sends page data.
If selectors mode, extracts product data (query, image) using DOM selectors after waiting for elements or mutations.
If metadata mode, parses HTML and extracts product data from Schema.org, Open Graph, or HTML title after document interactive/load.
If required attributes (query, image, imageUrl) are found, it triggers the popup extension or catalogue redirection.
apis: fetch (indirectly via background for CMS/Catalog APIs)

workflows.name: User Authentication & Session Management
workflows.trigger: Login/Logout events from the web app (via window.postMessage to content script, then chrome.runtime.sendMessage to background).
steps: Web app sends 'login' or 'logout' message to content script.
Content script forwards 'login' or 'logout' message to background script via `chrome.runtime.sendMessage`.
Background script receives message, stores/clears `AUTH_KEY` and `AUTH_VALUE` in local/sync storage.
Background script queries all tabs and broadcasts `messageTypes.setAuth` or `messageTypes.clearAuth` to all active content scripts.
Content scripts receive updated auth status and forward to the web app via `window.postMessage`.

workflows.name: Extension UI Interaction & Display (Popup & Embedded)
workflows.trigger: User clicks browser action, user navigates to supported site, web app signals ready/has results.
steps: Background script determines if popup should be shown (based on URL and support).
Content script either injects a popup iframe or an embedded iframe (for supported hosts like Amazon, Google, Ecosia).
Web app communicates its readiness (`webAppReady`), result status (`hasResult`), or requests UI changes (`closeExtension`, `toggleEmbeddedAccordion`, `removeExtensionFromDOM`).
Content script adjusts iframe visibility (`showPopup`, `hidePopup`), size (`toggleEmbeddedView`), or removes it from DOM.
Popup UI language localized based on `navigator.language`.
Popup can be dragged by the user, with its position saved in session storage.

workflows.name: Image Search & Processing
workflows.trigger: User clicks 'Search this image on Faircado' context menu item or content script detects image for search.
steps: Background script receives context menu click event with `info.srcUrl` (image URL).
Background sends `messageTypes.showExtension` with `imageUrl` and `info` to content script.
Content script calls `getImageBaseDataByIframe` with the image URL.
`getImageBaseDataByIframe` dynamically creates and appends an invisible iframe (`save.html`) to `document.body`.
The `save.js` script inside the iframe receives the image URL via `window.postMessage`.
`save.js` loads the image (setting `image.crossOrigin = 'Anonymous'`), draws it onto a canvas, converts it to a JPEG data URL (base64 encoded).
`save.js` posts back the original `imgUrl` and the `imgData` (base64) to its parent (content script) via `window.parent.postMessage`.
Content script receives the image data and uses it to `popupExtension`.
endpoints: dynamic (request.data.url) - for fetching image in iframe

workflows.name: Catalogue Redirection Flow
workflows.trigger: Product page detection with 'extension_to_website' A/B test enabled, or image search in the content script.
steps: Content script checks if 'extension_to_website' A/B test is enabled.
If enabled, and required product attributes are found, it injects a 'faircado-catalogue-redirector' element into the DOM.
User clicks the redirector element.
Content script generates a unique `redirectionKey`.
Retrieves catalogue address (faircado.com or faircado.de) and machine key.
Stores page data and additional payload data (including triggering URL, source, query origin) in session storage under `redirectionKey`.
Opens a new tab to `${catalogueAddress}/redirect-handler?redirectionId=${redirectionKey}`.
Tracks 'experiment_click' or 'experiment_image_search' event to Mixpanel.
apis: chrome.runtime.sendMessage (to check A/B test state and get machine key)

workflows.name: Analytics & Error Reporting Flow
workflows.trigger: Various events within background and content scripts (e.g., extension install, user actions, errors).
steps: Content scripts send `messageTypes.mixpanel` or `messageTypes.error` messages to the background script.
Background script receives messages.
For `messageTypes.mixpanel`, it constructs a Mixpanel event payload with `MIXANEL_TOKEN`, `distinct_id` (machine key), `browser`, `time`, and `$insert_id`.
Sends a POST request to `https://api.mixpanel.com/track`.
For `messageTypes.error`, it extracts details (message, URL) and tracks a custom error event to Mixpanel.
Background script also updates Mixpanel user profiles for events like `extension_updated_on`.

workflows.name: Data Control & Privacy Consent Flow (Firefox Specific)
workflows.trigger: Browser action click (Firefox) or content script initialization (Firefox).
steps: In Firefox, the background script and content script check if the extension is 'activated' (meaning data control consent is given).
If not activated (for Firefox), clicking the browser action opens `data-control.html`.
The `data-control.html` page (which imports `data-control.js`) presents 'Activate' and 'Uninstall' buttons.
Clicking 'Activate' in `data-control.html` sets `STORAGE_KEY.ACTIVATED = '1'` in local storage and redirects to an after-install URL.
Clicking 'Uninstall' in `data-control.html` triggers `browser.management.uninstallSelf({ showConfirmDialog: false })`.

workflows.name: External Application Integration Flow
workflows.trigger: External web application sends a 'message' event to the content script with `source: 'faircado'` and `type: 'getFromExtensionStorage'`.
steps: Content script listens for `window.message` events from external apps, filtering by `event.data.source === 'faircado'`.
If `type` is `getFromExtensionStorage`, it validates `key`, `selfId`, and `area` from the message.
Retrieves the requested data from the specified `storageArea` (local, sync, or session storage).
Sends a `getFromExtensionStorageResponse` message back to the external app via `event.source?.postMessage`, including `selfId` and `storageData`.
If `shouldRemoveAfterReading` is true, it removes the item from storage.

workflows.name: Navigation Monitoring Flow
workflows.trigger: Browser history changes (pushState, replaceState, popstate) or content script initialization.
steps: Content script injects `navigation-events.js` into the page.
`navigation-events.js` overrides `history.pushState` and `history.replaceState` and listens for `popstate` events.
When a navigation event occurs, `navigation-events.js` sends a `window.postMessage` with type `pushStateFaircado`, `replaceStateFaircado`, or `popstateFaircado` to the content script.
Content script listens for these messages, checks if the URL has actually changed.
If the URL changed, it triggers `checkPopupOnNavigation` (a debounced function) which re-evaluates page support and display.

components.name: Background Service Worker
components.description: Handles extension lifecycle, context menus, browser actions, message proxying for cached API data and storage, auth distribution, Mixpanel tracking, icon/popup management.

components.name: Content Script
components.description: Injected into web pages, communicates with background and web apps, injects helper scripts, extracts page data, manages embedded views and catalogue redirection, monitors UI and security.

components.name: Popup Script
components.description: Handles UI localization for the extension popup and provides hardcoded links.

components.name: Save Script (iframe)
components.description: Web-accessible script loaded in an iframe by the content script to fetch, resize, and base64-encode images.

components.name: Navigation Events Script (injected)
components.description: Web-accessible script injected by the content script to override browser history methods and listen for popstate events, reporting navigation changes to the content script.

components.name: External Web App (Faircado Web App)
components.description: External web application served within iframes (popup/embedded) by the extension, interacting via window.postMessage.

components.name: Faircado Catalogue
components.description: External web application for product catalogue, target of redirection workflows.

risks.name: Data Transmission to Third Parties
risks.description: Machine key, browser information, and current URL are transmitted to Mixpanel for analytics. The current URL is also sent to Faircado Catalog Service API for website support checks.
risks.justification: Analytics data and website compatibility checks involve sending user-associated data to external services. While common, this is a privacy consideration.

risks.name: Potential for PII Exposure (OAuth2 Email Scope)
risks.description: The OAuth2 configuration requests the 'userinfo.email' scope, indicating the potential to access the user's email address. No direct code was observed for handling or transmitting this email in the provided files, but the permission exists.
risks.justification: The permission to access user email exists, which is a privacy concern. However, no explicit code was found using this permission to collect or transmit email addresses.

risks.name: Dynamic Content Loading/Injection Risk
risks.description: The extension dynamically creates iframes and injects scripts (save.js, navigation-events.js) and loads content from 'https://extension-v3-8.faircado.com'. This increases the attack surface if these external resources are compromised or malicious.
risks.justification: Loading and injecting external scripts and iframes introduces a dependency on the security of the served content. While the CSP provides some protection, the broadness of img-src and 'unsafe-inline' for style-src in extension_pages might allow for certain attacks if an included external resource is malicious.

risks.name: Sensitive Data in Session Storage (Redirection)
risks.description: Page data (which can contain product information like query, image, color, brand) is temporarily stored in session storage using a dynamically generated redirectionKey before a catalogue redirection. While session storage is typically cleared when the session ends, it is client-side storage.
risks.justification: Storing potentially sensitive product data client-side, even temporarily, has a low risk of exposure if the user's browser is compromised during the active session. This data is not observed to be transmitted to unintended third parties from session storage directly.
